subject: English
question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: Zahir dreamed of a democratic society where freedom of speech and expression would be (a) -------. He also had strong hopes for the development of the film industry. His legendary film Jibon Theke Neya, inspired by the 1952 Language Movement, was a (b) ------- against the autocratic regime. The film symbolically portrayed East Pakistan through a family ruled by a dictator. During the Liberation War, it was shown abroad and admired by famous directors like Satyajit Ray and Mrinal Sen. Zahir donated all his film income to the Freedom Fighters’ (c) -------. His documentary Stop Genocide played a vital role in creating (d) ------- support for Bangladesh's (e) ------- struggle. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) ensured; (b) revolt; (c) trust; (d) global; (e) liberation;
